Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_Enabled_toolt: When off, the server refuses every build request from this mod. Things already built stay.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_WhoCanUse_too:
Everyone: every player can build.
Admins only: only players allowed to use the build cheat can build.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_WhereCanBuild:
Like vanilla: unclaimed land, and safehouses where the player may build.
Own safehouses only: only inside safehouses where the player may build.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_MaxDistance_t: 2 to 8 tiles from the player to the nearest square of the item. The item can be at most one floor above or below.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_MaxCellsPerDr: 1 to 64. How many items one build or dismantle can take, for example dragging an area of floor or dismantling an area.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_CostMultiplie: 0 to 10. Multiplies every material amount, rounded up. 0 means no materials; tools are still needed. Objects that dismantle into materials by their own material type (most furniture), curtains and removable light bulbs never go below 1, so dismantling never gives back more than was paid. Admins with the build cheat on never pay.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_ZombieProof_t:
When on, zombies don't attack walls, fences, posts, stairs, furniture, containers or blocking lights built with this mod, and don't path through them. Player weapons can't break them either; sledgehammers and dismantling still work. Zombies still climb over low fences like vanilla, and crawling zombies still bang on them but can't break them. Doors have their own option. Windows and boards nailed over them still break like vanilla.
Things already built change only when their area loads again: restart the server in multiplayer, reload the save in singleplayer.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_ZombieProofDo:
When on, doors built with this mod get very high durability: zombies still bang on them but can't break them, and player weapons can't either. Sledgehammers still work. Doors built before this option existed aren't recognized and break like vanilla.
Doors already built change only when their area loads again: restart the server in multiplayer, reload the save in singleplayer.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_ContainerCapa:
1 to 10. Multiplies the capacity of containers built with this mod, rounded, up to 100, the game's limit. Fridge freezers too.
Containers already built change only when their area loads again: restart the server in multiplayer, reload the save in singleplayer.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_DisabledSourc: Mod IDs separated by semicolons. Tiles from these mods cannot be built. By default the Minidoracat family mods and mods whose tiles belong to their own build menus are off.
Sandbox_MinidoracatBuilder_DisabledTiles: Tileset names separated by semicolons, for example walls_exterior_house_01. Tiles from these tilesets cannot be built.
